Bourbon Glazed BBQ Chicken Recipe

Ingredients 

* Apple cider vinegar 2 cups
* Bourbon 1 1/2 cups
* Brown sugar 3 1/2 cups
* Salt 2 Tbs
* Onion powder 2 Tbs
* Garlic powder 2 Tbs
* Celery seed 2 Tbs
* Black pepper 1 Tbs
* Paprika 1 Tbs
* Lard 2 Tbs
* Pickling spices 1/4 cup
* Whole chicken cut in half.

Directions

In a saucepan combine lard, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, salt, onion powder, garlic powder, celery seed, black pepper, paprika, and pickling spices. Stir and bring it to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer until the sauce thickens and gets a glaze consistency.
Place chicken on the BBQ with the inside facing down on indirect heat. Cook at 275°F for 1.5 to 2 hours or until an internal temperature of 165-175 degrees. When nearly cooked, apply glaze to both sides of the chicken and allow the chicken to fully cook. Once cooked, pull chicken from the BBQ and let it rest for a few minutes then enjoy.
